noun_definition: Accounting refers to the section within the Expensify app where users can manage financial integrations and settings related to their workspaces.

Set up button refers to the interactive element in the Accounting section of the Expensify app that is intended to initiate the setup process for QBO integration, which is expected to be visually centered relative to the "QBO" wording.
qbo wording refers to the text label associated with QuickBooks Online that is used as a reference point for the alignment of the "Set up" button in the user interface.
